description: Na₅H₄O₄Br crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are seven inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to two equivalent H, four O, and two equivalent Br atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaH₂Br₂O₄ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 59°. Both Na-H bond lengths are 2.53 Å. There are two shorter (2.40 Å) and two longer (2.58 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-Br bond lengths are 3.15 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two H, four O, and two equivalent Br atoms. There is one shorter (2.50 Å) and one longer (2.54 Å) Na-H bond length. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.57 Å. There is one shorter (3.03 Å) and one longer (3.11 Å) Na-Br bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent Br atoms. There are three shorter (2.42 Å) and one longer (2.44 Å) Na-O bond length. Both Na-Br bond lengths are 3.28 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O and two equivalent Br atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaBr₂O₄ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.43 Å. Both Na-Br bond lengths are 3.09 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two H, four O, and two equivalent Br atoms. There is one shorter (2.38 Å) and one longer (2.71 Å) Na-H bond length. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.75 Å. Both Na-Br bond lengths are 3.16 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent Br atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.44 Å. There is one shorter (3.24 Å) and one longer (3.36 Å) Na-Br bond length. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent Br atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.44 Å. There is one shorter (3.20 Å) and one longer (3.21 Å) Na-Br bond length. There are five inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to five Na and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to five Na and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to five Na and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to five Na and one H atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to five Na and one H atom. Br is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten Na atoms.
